I didn't think 8 was worth it when it came out. They've added things since, but still... it just doesn't quite move me.

In before all the "you need to spend money to make money" or "I care about my music enough to pay" people. I don't have an unlimited trust fund, and I DID just buy Ableton Live 9—I'm willing to spend money WHEN IT GETS ME SOMETHING. Case in point, I almost got Bitwig instead, but when I learned Bitwig doesn't ReWire, Live was pretty much the only choice—I love Reason, and I can't stand the idea of abandoning all that stuff; I have some pretty awesome REs I like, too.

I am still Reason-faithful; I almost certainly will upgrade when 9 comes out. One of the things I like about Propellerheads is, unlike some companies of late (ADOBE) they let you skip a few versions before upgrading. This policy really takes the sting out of their upgrades—if you don't feel it's worth it now, wait until it is!

Frankly, if you don't need collaboration and you're not bothered by the clumsy pre-8 file browsing, 8 doesn't have much to offer, if only because 7 IS ALREADY SO COMPLETE AND AWESOME. We'll see what expanded abilities for new REs, etc., will bring...
